description: Builds an SPF TXT record from a mail setup: sending IPs, mail providers such as Google or Microsoft, the a and mx mechanisms and soft or hard fail. Returns the record, a DNS lookup estimate and findings.

a.description: Allow the domain's own A record to send mail.

all.description: ~ for soft fail (default) or - for hard fail.

domain.description: The domain the record is for, such as example.com. Optional.

includes.description: Other domains to include, such as spf.mailjet.com.

ip4.description: IPv4 addresses or CIDR ranges that send mail, such as 203.0.113.5 or 198.51.100.0/24.

ip6.description: IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges that send mail.

mx.description: Allow the domain's MX hosts to send mail.

providers.description: Mail providers to include. One of: google, microsoft, mailjet, sendgrid, mailgun, ses, zoho, brevo, mailchimp.

name: spf_record_generator
title: SPF record generator
